notes.title: Now in color!
notes.content:
In the following weeks I'll be releasing the first demo version for the game!

And we have a new look for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534024/f8852a89f3860d12f743526f3ae0e7f947530815.png[/img]

You can see on the thumbnails a sneak peek to the upcoming features, like Lexeme and Concept management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534024/c667339cb0dd8f922e3e021febc2830529ae1dc5.png[/img]

Looking forward to share the Demo with all of you!!
